narr: Bu haftalarda biz ingliz tilida bashorat qilish va prognozlash atamalarini o'rganamiz.
Keling, misollarni ko'rib chiqaylik.

data.heading: Bashorat va prognoz misollari
bullets: We project improved sales in the coming months.
As you can see from the chart, we forecast increased research and development spending next year.
We predict improving sales through June.

narr: Birinchidan, 'project' so'zi kelgusi oylarda savdani yaxshilanishini bashorat qilish uchun ishlatiladi.
Ikkinchidan, 'forecast' so'zi keyingi yil tadqiqot va ishlanmalarga sarmoyani oshirish prognozini ifodalaydi.
Uchinchidan, 'predict' so'zi iyungacha savdani yaxshilanishini bashorat qiladi.
Endi biz o'zgarishlarni tasvirlaydigan sifatlar va ravishlarni o'rganamiz.

data.heading: Sifat — ravish ma'nolari va misollar
rows: There's been a slight decline in sales. / Sales have declined slightly over the past two months.
Investment rose sharply during the first quarter. / We made a sharp increase in investment.
Sales dropped abruptly in March. / There was an abrupt drop in sales in March.
We expanded rapidly throughout Canada. / The company made a rapid expansion throughout Canada.
Unfortunately, consumer interest suddenly decreased. / There was a sudden decrease in consumer interest in January.

narr: Birinchi jadvalda 'slight' va 'slightly' so'zlari ahamiyatsiz degan ma'noni anglatadi.
'Sharp' va 'sharply' tez yoki katta o'zgarishlarni bildiradi.
'Abrupt' va 'abruptly' kutilmagan o'zgarishlarni anglatadi.
'Rapid' va 'rapidly' juda tez o'sishni bildiradi.
'Sudden' va 'suddenly' esa ogohlantirmasdan yuz beradigan o'zgarishlarni ifodalaydi.

data.heading: Sifat — ravish ma'nolari va misollar (davomi)
rows: We've dramatically improved customer satisfaction over the past six months. / As you can see from the chart, the dramatic growth has come after we invested in a new product line.
The markets have reacted calmly to recent developments. / As you can see from the graph, consumers have been calm over the past few months.
Profit has been flat over the past two years.
There has been a steady improvement over the past three months. / Sales have improved steadily since March.

narr: 'Dramatic' va 'dramatically' so'zlari juda katta o'zgarishlarni bildiradi.
'Calm' va 'calmly' bozorlarning so'nggi rivojlanishlarga tinch reaktsiyasini anglatadi.
'Flat' so'zi o'zgarishsiz holatni bildiradi, masalan, foyda ikki yil davomida o'zgarmagan.
'Steady' va 'steadily' esa bir xil darajadagi yaxshilanishni anglatadi.
Endi biz sabab va oqibatlarni ifodalovchi fe'llarni o'rganamiz.

data.heading: Sabab va oqibat fe'llari
rows: Her grandmother influenced / had a considerable influence on Sarah's choice of career.
Parental attitude largely determines how well a child adapts to school.
A good teacher motivates their students.

rows.tex: ularni ijobiy biror ishni qilishga undaydi

rows: The flow of traffic through the town is facilitated by the one-way system.
His speech provoked an angry response.

narr: Birinchi fe'l 'influence' - bu kimdirning qaroriga ta'sir ko'rsatish degan ma'noni anglatadi.
'Determine' fe'lida ota-onalarning munosabati bolaning makobga moslashishini belgilaydi.
'Motivate' fe'li o'quvchilarni ilmiy ishlarga undaydi.
'Facilitate' fe'li biror narsani osonlashtiradi.
'Provoke' fe'li esa odatda salbiy javobga sabab bo'ladi.

data.heading: Sabab va oqibat fe'llari (davomi)
rows: The explosion was triggered by the heat.

rows.tex: boshlab yuboradi, odatda to'satdan va salbiy narsani

rows: The tilting of the earth on its axis accounts for the change in the seasons.
Sid's determination springs / stems from his desire to improve the world.
The country's victory gave rise to a new mood in society.
Mobile technology contributed to the information revolution.

narr: 'Trigger' fe'li to'satdan va odatda salbiy hodisani boshlab yuboradi.
'Account for' fe'li biror narsani tushuntirish uchun ishlatiladi.
'Spring from' yoki 'stem from' iboralari kelib chiqishi natijasidir degan ma'noni anglatadi.
'Give rise to' fe'li yangi holat yuzaga kelishiga sabab bo'ladi.
'Contribute to' fe'li biror narsaga ta'sir etuvchi omillardan biri ekanligini bildiradi.

data.heading: Sabab va oqibat fe'llari (davomi 2)
rows: Their child was given drugs to stimulate growth.

rows.tex: biror narsaning rivojlanishiga yoki ishlashiga sabab bo'ladi

rows: Her exhibition generated a lot of interest.

rows.tex: biror narsaning ro'y berishiga yoki mavjud bo'lishiga sabab bo'ldi
sabab bo'ladi, ko'pincha tibbiy kontekstda ishlatiladi

rows: A teacher's presence can often inhibit teenagers' discussions.

rows.tex: ular boshqa holatda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lganidan kamroq erkin bo'lishiga to'sqinlik qiladi

rows: A number of benefits can be derived from this situation.

narr: 'Stimulate' fe'li biror narsaning rivojlanishiga yoki ishlashiga sabab bo'ladi.
'Generate' fe'li biror narsaning ro'y berishiga yoki mavjud bo'lishiga sabab bo'ladi.
'Induce' fe'li ko'pincha tibbiy kontekstda ishlatiladi va sabab bo'ladi.
'Inhibit' fe'li biror narsaga to'sqinlik qiladi.
'Derive from' iborasi biror narsa natijasida olinishini bildiradi.
Keyingi bo'limda biz sabab va oqibatlarni ifodalovot otlarni o'rganamiz.

data.heading: Sabab va oqibat otlari
rows: The incident set off a chain reaction which affected us all.

rows.tex: har biri keyingisiga sabab bo'ladigan o'zaro bog'liq voqealar ketma-ketligi

rows: The effect/impact of the film on the audience was very powerful.
Does the end justify the means?

rows.tex: end so'zi bu yerda maqsad (aim yoki goal) ma'nosida ishlatilishiga e'tibor bering

rows: The accident was the origin/source of her later problems.
There are several precedents for taking such a decision.

rows.tex: allaqachon ro'y bergan va xuddi shunday qilish uchun asos beradigan narsa

narr: 'Chain reaction' - bu har bir hodisa keyingisini keltirib chiqaradigan zanjir reaksiyasi.
'Effect' va 'impact' - bu biror narsaning ta'siri, lekin 'impact' predlog bilan ishlatiladi.
'End' va 'means' - bu maqsad va vositalar, 'end' so'zi maqsad ma'nosida ishlatiladi.
'Origin' va 'source' - bu boshlanish yoki sabab.
'Precedent' - bu oldin ro'y bergan va xuddi shunday qilish uchun asos bo'lgan holat.

data.heading: Sabab va oqibat otlari (davomi)
rows: What was the reason for his success / why he succeeded?

rows.tex: reason ko'pincha for yoki why bilan kelishiga e'tibor bering

narr: 'Reason' - bu sabab degan ma'noni anglatadi va ko'pincha 'for' yoki 'why' bilan birga keladi.

data.title: Qisqa nutq tuzilishi va yo'naltiruvchi til
data.subtitle: 3.1.7 Qisqa nutq tuzilishi va yo'naltiruvchi til (signposting)

narr: Oxirgi bo'limda biz qisqa nutq tuzilishi va yo'naltiruvchi iboralarni o'rganamiz.

data.heading: Yo'naltiruvchi iboralar
bullets: As we'll see from today's lecture...
In today's lecture I'd like to look at...
In this lecture, I'll be focusing on...

narr: Ma'ruzachilar o'z ma'ruzalarini tushuntirish uchun yo'naltiruvchi iboralardan foydalanadilar.
Bu iboralar tinglovchiga nimani tinglashini va qaysi tartibda tinglashini tushunishga yordam beradi.
Masalan, 'As we'll see from today's lecture' iborasi ma'ruzada ko'riladigan asosiy mavzuni oldindan e'lon qiladi.
'In today's lecture I'd like to look at' iborasi ma'ruzachining asosiy e'tibor qaratadigan mavzuni bildiradi.
'In this lecture, I'll be focusing on' iborasi esa ma'ruzachining asosiy e'tibor yo'nalishini ko'rsatadi.
